# Pablo

> AI-powered therapy documentation that eliminates clinician paperwork. Pablo
> generates SOAP notes from session transcripts with dual-method verification
> (LLM + classical NLP), with full source attribution and HIPAA-grade audit
> logging. Self-hosted on GCP (Cloud Run + Cloud SQL) or managed.

Pablo is a healthcare app. Anything you change here may touch Protected Health
Information (PHI). Read CLAUDE.md before editing — guardrails 1, 2, and 5 are
load-bearing and CI-enforced.

## Start here

- [README](README.md): product overview, quickstart, deploy paths.

## Agent infrastructure

- [.claude/skills/audit-coverage-check](.claude/skills/audit-coverage-check/SKILL.md): enforces guardrail #1 (PHI routes need AuditService).
- [.claude/skills/phi-log-scan](.claude/skills/phi-log-scan/SKILL.md): enforces guardrail #5 (no PHI in stdout).
- [.claude/skills/migration-lint](.claude/skills/migration-lint/SKILL.md): enforces guardrail #4 (models ship with migrations).
- [.claude/skills/slop-sweep](.claude/skills/slop-sweep/SKILL.md): scans for AI-slop patterns (banner comments, stacked any-suppressions, mock-data leaks).
- [.claude/skills/pentest](.claude/skills/pentest/SKILL.md): owner-authorized weekly pentest of the deployed app.
- [.claude/settings.json](.claude/settings.json): permission allowlist + deny rules for agent tools.
- [docs/internal/agent-readiness-assessment.md](docs/internal/agent-readiness-assessment.md): current readiness rating + roadmap.
- [docs/internal/ci-failure-matrix.md](docs/internal/ci-failure-matrix.md): retryable vs human-needed CI failures.

## Conventions agents must follow

- Backend: Python 3.13, Poetry, FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x. Always `poetry run`. Use `str | None`, not `Optional[str]`.
- Frontend: Next.js 15, TypeScript, Tailwind, shadcn/ui. Pablo brand palette (warm cream, honey, sage). DM Sans body, Fraunces headings.
- Tests: `make check` (lint + test) is the gate. CI is the backstop, not the primary loop.
- One file per domain concept, files under ~400 lines, no banner comments, no `as any` without a one-line justification.
